name: ana_sqrt_two_rec_closed_form
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ) : a n = 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 2 ^ (n + 1))
closed: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ), a n = 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 2 ^ (n + 1))
informal: Viète-type closed form: the nested radical sequence equals 2cos(π/2^(n+1)) — induction using the half-angle identity 2 + 2cos(2t) = 4cos^2 t and positivity of cos on (0, π/2].
